supportedRange: DOCX body top-level editable freeform paths with a safe original DrawingML geometry model.
Move, line, quadratic Bezier, cubic Bezier, and close command identity with integer coordinates and path-specific viewports.
Control-point edits for quadratic and cubic commands when the shape has no rotation or flips and every edited coordinate is inside its path viewport.
safetyBoundary: The operation is exposed only for body top-level freeforms with safe source metadata and an unrotated, unflipped frame.
Out-of-viewport coordinates, unsupported DrawingML path structures, and unsupported source metadata fail closed.
Path insertion/deletion is tracked separately as P4-DX-PATH; transformed-path editing is tracked as P4-PATH-XFM.
changedComponents: external/wordcraft/crates/doc/src/freeform.rs: typed path commands, exact source coordinates and control-point mutation.
external/wordcraft/crates/docx/src/read/freeform.rs and crates/docx/src/write/story.rs: DrawingML path parsing and lossless edited-path serialization.
external/wordcraft/crates/engine/src/cmd/objects.rs: path point mutation and history behavior.
src-tauri/src/adapters/wordcraft/engine.rs: bounded path view, ownership/transform/viewport validation, T009-backed mutation routing.
src/adapters/docx.ts and src/components/Editor/DrawingMlPathEditor.tsx: strict IPC view parsing and point editing UI.

checks: DOCX quadratic/cubic source commands, control points, path attributes and viewport survive parse/serialize.
Edited paths preserve command identity and coordinates; unaffected source paths use their original XML.
Bezier rendering and pathPoint Undo/Redo behavior pass focused tests.
The generated quadratic/cubic DOCX fixture parses and renders in WordCraft.
Supported path-point edits pass the DOCX save-preservation gate; out-of-viewport input is rejected without changing export bytes or history.

native.environment: Linux X11/Xvfb with a test-owned private IBus 1.5.33 Hangul session and the Tauri WebDriver; this is X11 evidence, not Wayland evidence.
checks: Trusted native pointer input selected both quadratic and cubic control handles; trusted native keyboard input changed the displayed integer coordinates.
Undo and Redo restored exact before/after coordinates for both curve commands.

Independent DOCX inspection confirmed the saved quadratic control point changed from [127000, 63500] to [147000, 73500] and the cubic second control point changed from [508000, 127000] to [528000, 137000].
The saved word/document.xml matched the original XML after applying only those two point-coordinate changes; document relationships and all other 8 package parts were byte-identical.
T009 save reported state=saved, synced=true, changedSince=false, with no findings; a fresh app session reopened the file and reported both edited coordinates, dirty=false and unpreserved=false.
The test-owned Native launcher removed its X11/IBus/session resources and all test processes; no surviving test process was reported.
Launcher cleanup evidence: target/stage3a-p4-docx-curve/native-session-9/cleanup.json (complete=true, proven=true, filesystemProven=true, survivors=[]).
